title: Experimental and Clinical Studies of Retinal Stimulation
official: Experimental and Clinical Studies of Retinal Stimulation
summary: The study will evaluate new methods of retinal stimulation and training with the goal of improving the visual ability of retinal prosthesis participants.

interventions.name: New visual processing unit (VPU) with asymmetric waveforms

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be implanted with an Argus II Retinal Prosthesis system.
* Have 5 or more electrodes that create a perception with stimulation.
* Must be willing and able to comply with the protocol testing requirements.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects participating in another investigatory drug or device study
* Any disease or condition that prevents understanding or communication of informed consent, study demands, and testing protocols.
